prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: The parent's locality coefficient 0.3 is a compromise; scaling it down to 0.15 halves the term's pull so it can no longer drag the cut term away from a good global cut on circuits where critical-pair structure is weak (C2), keeping C1's locality benefit while restoring C2/C3 robustness.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=+0.040 robust(mean-std)=-0.007 min_case=-0.010 seed_std=0.020 tns_mean=+0.012 all_valid=True
  C1: score=+0.040 dWNS=+6.9% dTNS=+2.4% per-seed=[+0.06 -0.00 +0.06]
  C2: score=+0.011 dWNS=+1.1% dTNS=+1.0% per-seed=[+0.01 +0.00 +0.01]
  C3: score=-0.010 dWNS=-1.6% dTNS=+0.2% per-seed=[-0.02 +0.02 -0.04]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->136, wcut 421->418, crit_cross 0.011->0.011, repair_flips 103->103, changed-vs-baseline 1.8%
  C2: cut 318->316, wcut 1007->992, crit_cross 0.000->0.000, repair_flips 238->238, changed-vs-baseline 1.9%
  C3: cut 582->586, wcut 1955->1973, crit_cross 0.069->0.076, repair_flips 353->353, changed-vs-baseline 1.2%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response: (1) Partially. C1 keeps its gain (+0.040) and C2 improves slightly (+0.011), but C3 regresses (-0.010), so the "restore C2/C3 robustness" claim fails for C3. (2) C1/C2 cut and wcut drop slightly with unchanged crit_cross and repair_flips—consistent with weaker locality pull letting the cut term optimize freely where critical pairs are sparse. C3 shows cut 582→586, wcut 1955→1973, crit_cross 0.069→0.076: weaker locality lets critical pairs cross, hurting dWNS (-1.6%). (3) Seed spread is high (std 0.020; C3 per-seed -0.02/+0.02/-0.04), marginal. (4) Make locality coefficient circuit-adaptive (scale with crit_cross density) rather than a fixed 0.15.
